host.placement: primary, standby and client on one host; no CPU pinning; not isolated from other host activity

compare-hybrid-screen.primary_config:
max_connections = 100			# (change requires restart)
shared_buffers = 128MB			# min 128kB
dynamic_shared_memory_type = posix	# the default is usually the first option
max_wal_size = 1GB
min_wal_size = 80MB
log_timezone = 'Etc/UTC'
autovacuum_worker_slots = 16		# autovacuum worker slots to allocate
datestyle = 'iso, mdy'
timezone = 'Etc/UTC'
lc_messages = C				# locale for system error message
lc_monetary = C				# locale for monetary formatting
lc_numeric = C				# locale for number formatting
lc_time = C				# locale for time formatting
default_text_search_config = 'pg_catalog.english'
listen_addresses = '127.0.0.1'
port = 56532
unix_socket_directories = '/dev/shm/pgpg2-hybrid-screen-data'
max_connections = 158
shared_buffers = '256MB'
max_wal_senders = 4
wal_level = replica
wal_buffers = '64MB'
max_wal_size = '512MB'
min_wal_size = '80MB'
checkpoint_timeout = '30min'
autovacuum = off
fsync = on
full_page_writes = on
synchronous_standby_names = 'bench_standby'

notes: All completed rows are retained, including regressions.
The repeated candidate, 8, was selected after the short screens; it is not established as an optimal threshold.
All datasets use tmpfs data, tmpfs client logs, fsync=on, full_page_writes=on, one synchronous standby, synchronous_commit=on, and a persistent physical replication slot.
Parent, standby and client share one host without pinning or host isolation.
The on control uses the new feature binary with direct limit 0, retaining fully delegated wakeups.
The initial measured binary defaults the direct limit to 0; hybrid variants explicitly set their limits.
Full per-transaction gzip logs and server logs remain in /home/reshke/pgpg2/<dataset>/ on the benchmark host.
